items.title: Truck Left
items.subject: camera
items.description: Lateral movement to the left, camera facing held constant (not a pan - the camera does not rotate).
items.keywords: truck left, lateral move, slide left, strafe
items.tracksSketch: one position track on the camera's local-right axis, offset op, ease power2.inOut; rotation untouched

items.title: Truck Right
items.subject: camera
items.description: Lateral movement to the right, camera facing held constant.
items.keywords: truck right, lateral move, slide right, strafe
items.tracksSketch: mirror of truckLeft on the same axis, opposite sign

items.title: Push In (Small)
items.subject: camera
items.description: A small, gentle push toward the subject - the restrained sibling of dollyIn for a brief that wants barely-there tension, not a full dolly.
items.keywords: push in small, subtle push, gentle approach, micro dolly
items.tracksSketch: dolly op, small distance factor (~0.92 of current radius), ease power2.inOut, shorter duration than dollyIn's default

items.title: Pull Out (Large)
items.subject: camera
items.description: A large pull-out beyond dollyOut's default range - for a big scale reveal at the end of a sequence.
items.keywords: pull out large, big reveal, scale reveal, wide release
items.tracksSketch: dolly op, large distance factor (~2.2-3x current radius), ease power3.out so it settles rather than drifts past the target framing

items.title: Arc 30
items.subject: camera
items.description: A fixed 30-degree partial arc around the subject - arcShot's named-angle sibling for a brief that specifies the exact sweep instead of 'some'.
items.keywords: arc 30, 30 degree arc, partial orbit, side reveal
items.tracksSketch: orbit op, angle delta fixed at 30deg, ease power2.inOut

items.title: Boom Up
items.subject: camera
items.description: A vertical rise that stays framed on the subject the whole time (unlike craneUp, which ascends more freely).
items.keywords: boom up, framed rise, vertical lift keeping subject centered
items.tracksSketch: position.y offset track PLUS a rotation.x compensation track keyed together so the subject stays centered in frame through the rise

items.title: Lateral Dolly Rack Focus
items.subject: camera
items.description: A lateral dolly with a depth-of-field rack: focus pulls from one distance to another across the same window as the lateral move.
items.keywords: rack focus, lateral dolly with focus pull, dof sweep
items.tracksSketch: position track (lateral offset) PLUS a post-pass track {kind:'post', passId:<dofPassId>, key:'focus'} keyed from the start distance to the end distance over the same duration; requires an addPostPass postKind:'dof' already on the scene

items.title: Orbital Tilt
items.subject: camera
items.description: An orbit that also tilts the camera's pitch across the arc instead of staying level.
items.keywords: orbital tilt, tilting orbit, canted arc
items.tracksSketch: orbit op position sweep PLUS a rotation.x track ramping a few degrees across the same window

items.title: Probe Pass 18
items.subject: camera
items.description: A close pass BY the subject at 18 degrees off its forward axis - the camera travels past rather than circling around.
items.keywords: probe pass 18 degrees, close pass, flyby
items.tracksSketch: a short guide path (addNode path, bevel:null) laid at 18deg off the subject's forward axis; attachCameraToPath role:'camera' mount:'onCurve'; keyframe the returned offset target 0 to 1

items.title: Probe Pass 29
items.subject: camera
items.description: Same as probePass18 at 29 degrees off the subject's forward axis.
items.keywords: probe pass 29 degrees, close pass, flyby
items.tracksSketch: identical mechanism to probePass18, guide path angled at 29deg

items.title: Probe Pass 47
items.subject: camera
items.description: Same as probePass18 at 47 degrees off the subject's forward axis - a sharper, more oblique pass.
items.keywords: probe pass 47 degrees, close pass, oblique flyby
items.tracksSketch: identical mechanism to probePass18, guide path angled at 47deg

items.title: FPV Dive
items.subject: camera
items.description: A first-person dive toward and past the subject, riding a guide-path rail.
items.keywords: fpv dive, first person dive, drone dive, dive through
items.tracksSketch: guide path (bevel:null) shaped as a dive curve toward/through the subject; attachCameraToPath role:'camera' mount:'onCurve', takeOver:true if the camera is already parented; keyframe the offset target 0 to 1, ease power2.in for the accelerating dive feel

items.title: Spiral Crane
items.subject: camera
items.description: An orbit that also rises - a spiral combining orbital sweep with vertical lift.
items.keywords: spiral crane, rising orbit, helix move
items.tracksSketch: orbit op position sweep PLUS a position.y ramp over the same duration, both eased power2.inOut

items.title: Crest and Tilt to Plumb
items.subject: camera
items.description: The camera crests over the subject then tilts down to a straight-down (plumb) view.
items.keywords: crest and tilt to plumb, top-down reveal, overhead tilt down
items.tracksSketch: a position arc rising over the subject (craneUp-style) followed by a rotation.x sweep to -90deg (straight down), sequenced with startSec staging one after the other

items.title: Eye-Level Glide
items.subject: camera
items.description: A slow, level, deliberate lateral glide at subject eye height - smoother and more directional than handheldDrift's ambient jitter.
items.keywords: eye level glide, smooth lateral drift, level glide
items.tracksSketch: position track along the lateral axis at a fixed height, linear-ish ease (a very gentle power1.inOut), loop-closed so it can repeat seamlessly

items.title: Motorized Drift
items.subject: camera
items.description: A very slow, mechanical-feeling continuous drift - reads as motorized rather than organic.
items.keywords: motorized drift, mechanical drift, constant slow pan
items.tracksSketch: position or rotation track, LINEAR ease throughout (never power*, which would read as organic/eased rather than mechanical), loop-closed

items.title: Speed Ramp Slow-Mo
items.subject: camera
items.description: A time-warp on a clip's own playback speed (a speed ramp into slow motion). NOT BUILDABLE TODAY - f0 has no clip-level time-remap track. Documented here as unsupported until one exists; do not fake it with a slower camera move, which changes the camera's speed, not the footage's.
items.keywords: speed ramp, slow motion, time warp, unsupported
items.tracksSketch: UNSUPPORTED - requires a new clip time-remap track type that does not exist in the current animation schema

items.title: Final Hold
items.subject: camera
items.description: Not a move - a deliberate still beat at the end of a sequence. The closing track in a chained shot list feeding flowmo-video-prompt-craft's continuity rules.
items.keywords: final hold, closing still, settle and hold, end beat
items.tracksSketch: the last authored keyframe simply repeats with no further motion for the hold's duration; no new track kind needed, just an extra key at the same value

items.title: Levitation
items.subject: node
items.description: A slow vertical float with a gentle rotation drift for an object meant to read as weightless - floatBob's larger-amplitude, slower-period sibling.
items.keywords: levitation, floating object, weightless, hover
items.tracksSketch: position.y sine-shaped track (larger amplitude, slower period than floatBob) plus a slow rotation drift on one or two axes, loop-closed

items.title: Explode Along Axis
items.subject: node
items.description: NOT a single-subject preset - a GROUP recipe: even spacing of several components along one axis, keyed out and back in reverse order. See flowmo-3d-scene-recipes's exploded-product recipe for the full multi-node op sequence; this entry exists as a named-move cross-reference only.
items.keywords: explode along axis, exploded view, assembly breakdown
items.tracksSketch: one position track per component group along the chosen axis, staggered startSec per component, reassembly (second half of the timeline) reverses the out-order; see flowmo-3d-scene-recipes

items.title: Ignition Rise
items.subject: node
items.description: A material/layer effect (emissive sweep, wireframe-to-PBR opacity crossfade along an axis), not a transform move. Scene3DMotionPreset tracks only cover position/rotation/scale/fov/lens, not material channels - this cannot become a literal preset entry without a new channel kind. Build directly with keyframe_scene targeting the material/layer ExposedTarget instead. See flowmo-3d-scene-recipes's blueprint-to-building recipe.
items.keywords: ignition rise, emissive sweep, materialize, wireframe to solid
items.tracksSketch: NOT EXPRESSIBLE as a Scene3DMotionPreset track today - author via keyframe_scene targeting {kind:'material', nodeId, path:'opacity', layerId} and/or a depthGradient layer's range along the chosen axis; see flowmo-3d-scene-recipes
